body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Digifi(www.digifi.kr) showcased its new wireless headphone 'Opera S6' at the 2009 CES in Las Vegas.
Coming with dongle adaptor, the Opera S6 supports up to 10m range. Featuring 3D surround on/off key, it offers up to 10 hours of playing time with 3 hours of charging.
The Opera S6 will be available in May for Korea market and in July for global market.
